title: Estimator program exact cost
statement: Let $n\in\mathbb{N}$, let $f:\{-1,1\}^n\to\{-1,1\}$ be a Boolean function, let $\mathcal{F}$ be a nonempty finite family of subsets of $\{0,\ldots,n-1\}$, and let $0<\varepsilon\le 1/2$ be rational. Every outcome in the support of the estimator program's output-and-cost distribution has cost $(|\mathcal{F}|M,0,|\mathcal{F}|M+|\mathcal{F}|M(n+1))$, where the three entries count random examples, queries, and work, respectively, and $M$ is the prescribed number of samples per coefficient.
hypotheses_covered: $\mathcal{F}$ is a finite nonempty family of subsets of $\{0,\ldots,n-1\}$
The outcome belongs to the support of the estimator program's output-and-cost distribution
